screenings_recorded.label: Ibipimo byanditswe
screenings_recorded.description: Ibipimo byoherejwe muri icyo gihe (ibitararangira ntibibarwa).

distinct_patients_screened.label: Abantu bapimwe
distinct_patients_screened.description: Abarwayi batandukanye bafite nibura ipimwa rimwe ryoherejwe.

screenings_flagged.label: Ibipimo byagaragajwe
screenings_flagged.description: Ibipimo itegeko ry'igerageza ryagaragaje ko bikeneye isuzuma ry'umuganga.

reviews_pending.label: Isuzuma ritegereje
reviews_pending.description: Ibipimo byagaragajwe bitegereje isuzuma cyangwa birimo gusuzumwa.

reviews_completed.label: Isuzuma ryarangiye
reviews_completed.description: Ibipimo byagaragajwe byafatiwe icyemezo cyangwa byakuweho hatanzwe impamvu.

reviews_dismissed.label: Ibimenyetso byakuweho hatanzwe impamvu
reviews_dismissed.description: Ibimenyetso umuganga yakuyeho atanze impamvu. Ntibibarwa nk'ubuvuzi bwarangiye.

pathway_referred.label: Byoherejwe cyangwa byateganyirijwe gukurikiranwa
pathway_referred.description: Ibimenyetso byasuzumwe bifite koherezwa gukomeje cyangwa gukurikiranwa kwateganyijwe.

pathway_completed.label: Urugendo rw'ubuvuzi rwarangiye
pathway_completed.description: Ibipimo byoherejwe bifite koherezwa kwarangiye hamwe n'ibimenyetso cyangwa gukurikiranwa kwarangiye hamwe n'umusaruro n'ibimenyetso.

median_days_to_review.label: Iminsi yo hagati kugeza ku isuzuma
median_days_to_review.description: Iminsi yo hagati kuva ku ipimwa kugeza ku cyemezo cy'isuzuma, izengurutswe ku mubare umwe nyuma y'akadomo.

missing_glucose_unit.label: Igipimo cy'isukari kitagira igice
missing_glucose_unit.description: Ibipimo byoherejwe bifite agaciro k'isukari ariko nta gice cyanditswe.

possible_duplicate_identities.label: Imyirondoro ishobora kuba yisubiramo
possible_duplicate_identities.description: Abarwayi bagaragajwe ko bashobora kuba banditswe kabiri.

flags_overturned_at_review.label: Ibimenyetso byavanyweho mu isuzuma
flags_overturned_at_review.description: Ibimenyetso umuganga yakuyeho nyuma yo gusuzuma.

staff_time_minutes.label: Igereranya ry'igihe cy'abakozi (igerageza)
staff_time_minutes.description: Iminota yo kugerageza guhamagara wongeyeho igihe cyo kwandika ibipimo. Ni igereranya ry'igerageza, si igipimo nyacyo cy'akazi.

metric.staffTimeProxyNote: Igereranya ry'igihe cy'abakozi (igerageza) — si igipimo nyacyo cy'akazi.

placeholder.description: Iyi paji ni iy'agateganyo mu ishingiro rya porogaramu. Izatangwa mu cyiciro gikurikira.

notFound.title: Paji ntiyabonetse
notFound.description: Iyi aderesi ntihuye n'ipaji iyo ari yo yose muri iri gerageza.
